What their own code actually shows:
1. The crash game has no player seed. Provably fair normally means you add your own seed and results are computed from your seed plus theirs. In Gamdom's crash game the seed is one fixed constant hardcoded into the game file. It is the same for every player, every round, forever. Nothing about a round depends on you, and the house can know every upcoming result before anyone places a bet.
2. The crash formula carries a hidden house cut. The math in their code includes a term (a divide by 50) that is not part of the fair formula they describe publicly. There is also a built-in 1 in 100 chance that every round instantly crashes at 1.00x. Running their own formula, the real average return to players is about 97.8 percent, and it gets worse depending on where you cash out.
3. The payout rate is a live setting, not a fixed rule. Admins can change the house edge from a control panel, and the change even overrides the payout rate advertised by game providers. A game can be listed at one payout number and quietly repriced later.
4. For roulette and hilo, their own code comment admits the result mapping is "slightly biased because of modulo." They knew and wrote it down.
5. For dice, the player's seed is never saved to the database, so the "verify your result" feature cannot actually be used after the round.
6. The code also lets the system cut a crash round short and force-cash everyone out when total payouts hit a cap calculated from the live bets on the table.

TL;DR: The help page promises "the server seed is secret until reveal, nobody, the house included, can know your next result". Reality: the database stored the raw seed next to the hash, the crash game shipped with a fixed public seed so the house could see every result in advance, and the house edge was a runtime dial. That is not provably fair. That is trust-me with extra steps.

It has 6 employees and annual revenue of around 17 million Norwegian kroner, and since June 2025 it is part of Serit, one of Norway's largest independent IT groups with 27 offices and over 200 specialists. The company holds Helsenett certification for healthcare clients and runs its own Norwegian data center, keeping all data inside the country. It is led by founder and CEO Christopher Andreas Namtvedt, a former NATO systems administrator, together with CTO Ole Erik Skare who has been with the firm for 17 years. Core strengths are deep Bergen market knowledge combined with the national scale of Serit group partnerships with Microsoft, Fortinet, Dell and Lenovo. A newer focus is secure AI adoption and workflow automation for business clients.

nwmicro.com Northwest Micro Systems, formally Northwest Micro Inc., is a private IT services and software company founded in 1998 in Atlanta, Georgia, serving small businesses with managed IT, cloud backup, email, CRM and custom .NET development. Led by founder and owner Leo Zhadanovsky, it has around 11 employees and steady revenue of roughly 5 million dollars. Its unique model offers affordable one-time products like the One 2 One email server and Speed To Success CRM for about 100 dollars with lifetime updates and support. The company positions itself as the anti-corporate alternative to Oracle and Microsoft, focused on keeping small business clients for life. Core strengths are 28 years of market presence, a loyal SMB client base and a low-overhead operation. Its tech stack centers on Microsoft 365, SQL Server and .NET with a mix of SaaS and on-premise tools.

surexport.es Surexport is the largest independent berry producer in Europe, founded in 1994 in Huelva, Spain, growing strawberries, raspberries, blueberries and blackberries across Spain, Portugal, the Netherlands, Morocco and Kenya. Owned since 2020 by Alantra Private Equity, the group is valued at around 600 million euros with revenue approaching 400 million and over 2500 employees. Its competitive edge is exclusive berry varieties developed with US genetics partner Plant Sciences since 2007, sold under the Doñarosa, Berry Sensations and Fruhi brands. Major clients include Tesco, Lidl, Mercadona and Sainsbury's, with 80 percent of revenue from exports to Northern Europe. The company invested 200 million euros in acquisitions and secured a 250 million euro loan in 2025.

aslinsaat.com.tr ASL İnsaat is a Turkish construction company based in Istanbul, operating in civil and industrial building contracting both domestically and internationally. It provides full-cycle services including design, general contracting and project management for residential, commercial and industrial projects. The company is privately held with estimated staffing of several hundred employees scaling with active construction sites. Turkey is the world's second largest market for international construction contractors, and ASL operates within this competitive ecosystem. Key sectors are residential complexes, shopping centers, hotels, factories and infrastructure. Typical strengths of Turkish contractors like ASL are cost competitiveness, speed of delivery and experience in challenging geographies across the Middle East, Africa and Central Asia.

incomelec.com Incomelec is a Colombian company founded in 2006 in Bogota, the Latin American leader in pedestrian, vehicle and passenger access control including turnstiles and automated barriers. With 52 employees and operations in 14 countries, it has installed equipment in over 20 airports, 90 parking facilities and 250 buildings, handling more than 85 percent of Colombia's toll booth systems. Its flagship product is BIOMIG, an automated migration control system used at El Dorado and Medellin airports with iris scanning and passport verification. It is the exclusive regional partner of Automatic Systems from the Bollore Group and the only distributor worldwide that locally assembles TR-490 and TR-491 turnstile lines. Led by CEO Kris De Sutter Gomez, it serves Metro de Medellin, TransMilenio and BD Bacata, Colombia's tallest building.

epichealth.com.au Epic Health is an Australian medical group founded in 2001 in Melbourne, running multiple brands including Epic Medical general practice, Epic Youth Health, Epic Skin Health and Alevia Medical Weight Loss. Its fastest-growing division is Alevia, offering doctor-supervised weight loss programs using GLP-1 medications like Mounjaro and Ozempic across four clinics plus telehealth Australia-wide. The group combines traditional family medicine with niche verticals like dermatology, adolescent health and aesthetic medicine under one team-based model. Led by medical director Dr. Neeraj Mahindra, it serves patients nationally through Medicare-compatible telehealth with instant rebates and a dedicated digital app. Key strengths are 24 years of operation, a debt-free financial position and multi-brand diversification into high-demand health niches. The company is well positioned in Australia's booming medical weight loss and telehealth markets.

softwareone.com SoftwareOne Turkiye is the Turkish arm of SoftwareOne Holding AG, a Swiss-listed global software and cloud solutions provider that merged with Crayon to form a 13,000 person company operating in over 70 countries. Based in Ataşehir, Istanbul and active since 2019, it employs around 40 to 60 people and works with 100 percent of Turkey's top 50 companies and 80 percent of the top 500. Services span software licensing advisory for Microsoft, IBM and Oracle, cloud migration across Azure, AWS and Google Cloud, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, AI and FinOps. In December 2024 SoftwareOne AG acquired full ownership of the Turkish entity, approved by the Turkish Competition Authority. Led by Managing Director Doğa Pekdemir and CFO Hakan Keriş, it has delivered projects for Turkish Airlines, TAV Airports, Coca-Cola and Vakıf Katılım. Key strengths are its unmatched enterprise market coverage in Turkey and full access to the global SoftwareOne and Crayon ecosystem.

farmacias911.com.ec Gettareq S.A., known as Farmacias 911, is a major Ecuadorian pharmaceutical company founded in 2013 in Guayaquil, combining retail pharmacy, wholesale distribution, OEM manufacturing and medical consulting across the whole country. The group operates six brands including Farmacias 911 retail, ACOSAR wholesale distribution, Galenic for private label manufacturing, One Laboratory for quality testing and Conseplus for consulting. It has grown from 11 to 500 employees with a 166 percent increase in headcount, working with global pharmaceutical giants like Abbott, Bayer, Bristol Myers Squibb, Takeda and Roche. Led by founder and CEO Marlon Morillo, the company hosted Ecuador's largest pharmaceutical convention in 2025 alongside APESFA. Its vertical integration from import and production to retail and lab testing is unique in the Ecuadorian market.

sanirent.com.mx Grupo Sanirent is a 100 percent Mexican company founded in 1983 in Mexico City, the national leader in portable toilet rental, mobile offices, septic services and waste management. With 178 employees and operations in all 32 Mexican states, it serves everything from private events and luxury weddings to massive construction sites and industrial operations. Its business lines include standard and VIP portable toilets, camper-style luxury stations, mobile office rentals, industrial drain cleaning with specialized vactor and guzzler trucks, and full waste collection including hazardous and bio-infectious materials. The company holds ISO 9001 certification and has won 53 government contracts with major institutions like IMSS, CFE, CAPUFE and the National Culture Secretariat. Its premium Eventos Especiales division provides luxury sanitary facilities for high-end events across the country. Key strengths are 43 years of experience, full national coverage, diversified service.

starimagesouthlake.com StarImage Dental Boutique & Oral Surgery is a premium dental practice in Southlake, Texas, opened in January 2021 as the second location of StarImage Dentistry founded by Dr. James Green in Wichita Falls over 25 years ago. Led by Dr. Green, oral surgeon Dr. Dustin Van Tassell and Dr. Susan Millner, it offers cosmetic and reconstructive dentistry, dental implants, full mouth rehabilitation, oral surgery, TMJ treatment and sleep apnea care all under one roof. The clinic is one of the most technologically advanced dental offices in the US, equipped with Planmeca ProMax 3D CBCT imaging, MLS laser therapy, VELscope cancer screening and CT-guided implant surgery. Both lead doctors hold Fellow status at the Las Vegas Institute for Advanced Dental Studies, and the practice maintains a perfect 5.0 rating across 50 plus reviews. Its dedicated TMJ and Sleep Center provides a high-margin specialization in jaw disorders and obstructive sleep apnea.

wika-beton.co.id WIKA Beton (PT Wijaya Karya Beton Tbk) is Indonesia's largest precast and prestressed concrete manufacturer, founded in 1997 and listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange since 2014 as part of state-owned Wijaya Karya group. It operates over 20 production plants across Indonesia from Java to Papua, producing more than 189 types of concrete products including bridge girders, piles, culverts and railway sleepers. Revenue is estimated at around 5.3 trillion rupiah with a market cap of 1.9 trillion, offering a 3.5 percent dividend yield and trading well below book value. The company is a primary supplier for Indonesia's massive infrastructure boom including toll roads, the Jakarta-Bandung high-speed railway and new port construction. Led as a state-owned enterprise, it benefits from priority access to government contracts and a unique nationwide plant network.

atlasstamping.com Atlas Stamping Manufacturing Corp. is a US metal stamping company founded in 1971 in Richardson, Texas, producing precision stamped parts for automotive, aerospace, electronics, medical and industrial customers. With around 50 to 200 employees and estimated revenue of 5 to 20 million dollars, it operates a full-service plant offering progressive and transfer die stamping, deep draw, forming, welding and assembly. Its own tool and die shop designs and maintains all stamping dies in-house, giving full control over quality and lead times. Press capabilities range from 30 to 400 tons handling materials from thin foil to quarter-inch thick steel, aluminum and specialty alloys. The company has served the Dallas-Fort Worth industrial market for 54 years with ISO 9001 quality systems and PPAP compliance for OEM clients.

epmmop.quito.gob.ec EPMMOP is the Metropolitan Public Company of Mobility and Public Works of Quito, Ecuador, responsible for urban transportation infrastructure and public works across the capital district of 2.7 million people. It manages the city's integrated transport system including the new Quito Metro, launched in December 2023 as Ecuador's first subway line with 22.4 kilometers and 15 stations. The agency also operates the TelefériQo cable car, one of the highest in the world, plus trolleybus, BRT and cable car systems under the SITM integrated transit framework. It builds and maintains roads, bridges, sidewalks, drainage and one of Latin America's largest cycling networks. The company works within Quito's UNESCO World Heritage context, requiring unique engineering solutions for the historic center.

pureperfection.com Pure Perfection GmbH is a German live communication agency founded in 2008 in Wiesbaden, ranked number one in the 2026 BlachReport German Event Creativity Ranking ahead of insglück and Vok Dams. With 72 to 80 employees across offices in Wiesbaden, Berlin, Düsseldorf and Florida, it delivered 133 events in 2025, with 90 of them abroad including Shanghai, Miami and Singapore. Led by co-founders Jan Rogozinski and Kim Meisinger, the agency works through three units: Pure Live for events, Pure Space for brand spaces and architecture, and Pure Content for storytelling and PR. Major clients include Audi, ŠKODA, L'Oréal, Bentley and Nestlé, with pharma being its largest vertical at 90 events per year. Revenue peaked at 26.4 million euro in 2023 and the agency won 60 MUSE Creative Awards in 2026 alone.

belmontresorts.com Belmont Resorts is a small boutique hotel in McLeodganj, Dharamshala, Himachal Pradesh, operating as Hotel Satovari Pride on the Strawberry Hills with panoramic views of the snow-capped Dhauladhar mountains. It has just 14 rooms across four categories from Deluxe to Premium Gold corner suites with private balconies, mini-fridges and sunrise-sunset views from both sides. Positioned as a value-for-money alternative next to ITC Hotels and Lemon Tree, it offers a pure vegetarian restaurant with Jain cuisine, 24/7 power backup, fast WiFi and free parking. The hotel caters to relaxation, spiritual tourism, trekking and long-term workation stays with tour packages to Khajjiar and Dalhousie.

zinkanenterprises.com Zinkan Enterprises is a private US environmental services company founded in 1983 in Hunt Valley, Ohio, operating in water treatment, pond and lake management, oil and gas chemicals and waste management. With 45 to 75 employees and estimated revenue of 5 to 20 million dollars, it owns several brands including Pace Products, the creator of Freeze Free, the world's first anti-freeze pond coating dating back to the 1960s. Its Crystal Clear division manages ponds and water features for prestigious clients including Walt Disney World golf courses and the 2006 Open Championship at Royal Liverpool. Led by founder Thomas Zinkan, the company offers full-cycle solutions from chemical products to fountain equipment and contract pond maintenance. Core strengths are 42 years of experience, a unique patented anti-freeze technology and diversified revenue across four environmental service verticals.

malmsten.com Malmsten AB is a Swedish family-owned company founded in 1975 in Täby, the world's leading manufacturer of swimming pool and open water equipment including lane lines, buoys, starting blocks and safety gear. With around 30 employees and global distribution, its equipment has been used at 11 consecutive Olympic Games from Moscow 1980 to Paris 2024. Founder Robert Malmsten received the FINA Gold Pin Award in 2024 for 48 years of service to the international swimming federation's equipment committee. The company's proprietary wave calming technology reduces turbulence in competition lanes, making its Golden Series the gold standard for elite swimming events. Led by CEO David Malmsten in the second generation, it operates a subsidiary in Australia and serves 100 plus national swimming federations worldwide. Key strengths are FINA approval, Olympic heritage and a full product range from elite competition to public pool equipment.

betopiagroup.com Betopia Group Betopia Group is a Bangladeshi tech holding based in Dhaka, formally created in July 2025 by consolidating 22 business units including Bdcalling IT, Softvence, Sparktech, JVAI and Zencore, claiming 5,000 employees and 36 million dollars in annual revenue. Founded by Muhammad Monir Hossain, who went from freelancing on oDesk in 2013 to launching Bdcalling IT in 2017 with just 500,000 taka and 7 people, the group now serves clients in over 80 countries with 80 to 90 percent of business from the United States. Its units span software development, AI, cloud infrastructure via ZenexCloud, Odoo ERP implementation, renewable energy through PulseGrid and IT education. In July 2026 the group unveiled Vision 2030, planning to double its workforce and build Betopia City, an AI-powered smart tech hub in Bangladesh. The company is embroiled in a major scandal, with Fiverr suspending around 300 accounts linked to Betopia for coordinated marketplace manipulation.

acodafe.com Acodafe S.L. is a Spanish IT services company founded in 2009 in Mataró, Barcelona, providing managed IT, network installation, cybersecurity, cloud backups, data center hosting and GDPR consulting for small and medium businesses. Led by sole administrator Adrián Conde Kuller, it has just 4 employees and annual revenue between 500,000 and 1.5 million euro. The company grew sales by 22.8 percent in 2024 and climbed over 12,000 positions in Spain's national business ranking. Its services cover the full IT lifecycle for SMEs and industrial clients from system maintenance and installation to 24/7 emergency support. In 2019 it expanded into data protection consulting, a growing regulatory niche in Spain. Key strengths are 17 years of market presence, a lean and profitable operation and a diversified service portfolio tailored to small business needs.

unisa.es Unisa Shoes is a Spanish footwear company founded in 1973 in Elche, Alicante, with 52 years of history across three generations of the Pérez Parres family. It designs and produces women's, men's and accessories collections sold in 70 plus countries through around 30 own stores, 150 plus Espacio Unisa points of sale and its e-commerce platform. Revenue reached 25.3 million euro in 2024 with 145 employees, and international online sales hit a record 16 percent in 2025. Led by CEO Carlos Pérez Parres, the company launched its men's line in 2021 and an eco-friendly recycled suede collection, positioning itself as an accessible Spanish lifestyle brand. It opened a 300 square meter showroom in Madrid and a subsidiary in Italy to expand European distribution. Core strengths are family heritage, global reach across 70 countries and a diversified omnichannel sales model.

wabag.in VA Tech WABAG is the world's leading pure-play water technology company, founded in 1924 and headquartered in Chennai, India, operating in over 25 countries with 2000 engineers and over 1500 plants delivered. Listed on NSE and BSE, it posted record FY2026 revenue of 3944 crore rupees with PAT of 371 crore and has been net cash positive for 6 straight years with a credit rating of AA minus stable. Its order book surged to an all time high of 19400 crore rupees in Q1 FY2027, over 4 times annual revenue, backed by World Bank, ADB and JICA funded projects across India, the Middle East, Africa and Southeast Asia. Key projects include Southeast Asia's largest 400 MLD desalination plant in Chennai and a 300 MLD mega desalination order in Saudi Arabia. The company holds 125 plus proprietary patents and ranks 3rd globally among private water operators and desalination suppliers per Global Water Intelligence. Led by Chairman Rajiv Mittal.

lydenburg.toyota.co.za Lydenburg Toyota is a Toyota dealership in Lydenburg (Mashishing), Mpumalanga, South Africa, part of the Toyota South Africa Motors dealer network selling new Toyota and Lexus vehicles, certified used cars, service, parts and financial services. The town is also home to Toyota SA Manufacturing, the largest Toyota plant in Africa, assembling Hilux, Fortuner and Corolla Cross with engines and components exported to over 40 countries including the United States. Toyota SA Motors holds 24.2 percent of the South African vehicle market and exported 187 billion rand in FY2023, with 8500 direct employees across its plants. The company invested 2.43 billion rand in hybrid technology and is developing a 2.2 billion dollar Mbombela megaproject including housing, schools and hospitals around the Lydenburg plant. Corolla Cross production from Lydenburg began exports to the US in April 2024.

sap.com SAP Latin America and Caribbean is the regional arm of SAP SE, the world's largest enterprise software company, managing operations across 10 countries with about 6,000 employees led by President Adriana Aroulho since April 2025. Brazil is the standout market, cited in 40 straight quarters of global earnings for exceptional cloud revenue growth and now having more customers running on cloud than on-premise. The region serves over 5,000 clients in Brazil alone and holds 50 percent share among large Brazilian enterprises, with major wins including Grupo Nutresa, Honda South America, Votorantim, Chedraui and Motta Internacional. Through RISE with SAP and GROW with SAP, the company drives cloud ERP migration and Business AI adoption with its Joule assistant, targeting up to 30 percent productivity gains for clients. SAP's global cloud revenue reached 6.7 billion euro in Q3 2026 with the LatAm cloud market projected to double to 125 billion dollars by 2030.

ac-environnement.com Groupe AC Environnement is a French environmental engineering company founded in 1997 in Pontarlier, delivering integrated solutions for water treatment, wastewater, waste management and bioremediation. With 160 employees across five subsidiaries including GEG, Maraîch'Hydro and Biovéa, it has completed over 120 projects in 13 countries. Its standout project is the STEP des Voraces, France's first large-scale wastewater plant featuring demethanization serving 300,000 equivalent inhabitants. The group offers 26 specialized technical solutions spanning drinking water, industrial effluent, zero liquid discharge and circular economy applications. Led by Johan Hansma, it operates across the full project lifecycle from design and construction to long-term operations and maintenance.

tradeunionco.com tuc-dxb.com Trade Union Co. is a family-owned automotive spare parts wholesaler and retailer founded in 1960 in Beirut, Lebanon, with over 65 years of experience serving customers across the Middle East, Africa, Europe, Asia and the Americas. The group operates through its Beirut headquarters and The Trade Union International LLC in Dubai, a 5000 square meter global re-export hub established in 2007 with offices also in Germany, Russia and Nigeria. With over 150 employees and 20 plus international aftermarket brands including Bosch, Mahle, ZF and Sachs, it supplies parts for European, Japanese and American passenger and commercial vehicles. Led by CEO Walid El Bissani and Head of Strategy Tarek Jamil, the company is a member of NEXUS Automotive International, the world's largest automotive distribution community. It regularly exhibits at Automechanika Dubai and Frankfurt, showcasing its growing brand portfolio and global logistics network.

some.it SOME Srl is an Italian ERP and financial systems consulting company founded in 2001 in Milan, delivering end-to-end implementations of Epicor Kinetic, Infor SunSystems and Fluentis ERP for manufacturing, hospitality and oil and gas clients. With about 22 employees and revenue of 2.8 million euro, it has completed over 100 implementations across Europe, the Americas and North Africa. The company operates both as a system designer building ERP architectures and as a local specialist adapting global models to Italian fiscal and regulatory requirements. Led by Sales Director Franco Giannini and Partner Hussein Bahobeshi with 25 years of hospitality ERP expertise, it serves international hotel chains, oil companies like Mellitah and ENI Congo, and mid-size manufacturers.
